summary: Phase 4 CyberLab (AI analysis + Share/Export + Session/Admin rules + Attack-chain graph) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 19/19 passing after one stale-test fix. Frontend: /cyberlab AI panel, ShareModal + shareable URL creation, ReactFlow attack-chain viewer (6 nodes), Add-session-rule modal, and Admin CyberLab Rules tab all verified. Fixed one real integration bug (localStorage token key mismatch) that was preventing admin rules from loading.

minor.issue: Stale test in test_cyberlab.py expected flat list; response is now {builtin, admin, session}. Test updated to unwrap builtin.

ui_bugs.issue: Was reading localStorage key 'nivx.token' (dot) but AuthContext stores 'nivx_token' (underscore). Resulted in 'Load rules: HTTP 401' toast and empty rule list even for logged-in admin. FIXED — key aligned to 'nivx_token'. Admin CyberLab Rules tab now loads and Add-rule modal opens.

action_items: Verify the AdminCyberLabRules token-key fix is acceptable (E1 may want to standardize a single auth helper across admin components to avoid future key drift).
Optional: add a data-testid on the 'Sign in' button in Admin login (uses no type=submit, requires text match).
critical_code_review_comments: localStorage token key naming inconsistency between AuthContext ('nivx_token') and CyberLab session id ('nivx.cyberlab.sid') / prior admin component ('nivx.token'). Recommend centralizing token retrieval in a single helper (e.g. lib/auth.js) to prevent recurrence.

cyberlab/router.py export endpoints use ShareRequest with fields {input,output,trace,analysis,ai}. Any future consumers passing 'decoded' instead of 'output' will hit 422 silently (frontend already uses correct field, so no impact today).
seed_data_creation: One share doc auto-persisted via UI test (share_id=79d0c5acd3a6, 30-day TTL). No cleanup required — auto-expires.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 4 features working. Verified: (1) AI panel via Claude Sonnet 4.5 (~20s) returns Summary/Sigma/YARA tabs, (2) Share creates persisted URL, public GET returns 200, (3) Attack-chain ReactFlow renders 6 nodes with data-testid='attack-chain-viewer', (4) Session-rule modal opens via data-testid='add-session-rule-btn', (5) Admin tab data-testid='tab-cyberlab-rules' now loads without 401 and Add-rule modal works. PDF/MD direct API test needs {input,output,trace,analysis} — 'output' not 'decoded'. Existing pytest already covers PDF magic bytes/size.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug: Admin CyberLab Rules tab showed 'Load rules: HTTP 401' toast. RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/AdminCyberLabRules.jsx line 21 read localStorage.getItem('nivx.token') while /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx line 30 writes localStorage.setItem('nivx_token', ...). Repro: login as admin -> click CyberLab Rules tab -> observe toast + empty list. Mitigation applied: changed 'nivx.token' -> 'nivx_token' in AdminCyberLabRules.jsx. Verified fix by re-running the same flow — token length=215 present, no 401 toast, rules list renders, Add-rule modal opens.
